_readme: Curated East Coast India port dataset. Every field is an object {value, source, source_date}. Values unavailable from official/authoritative sources are recorded as the string 'UNKNOWN' and MUST NOT be estimated. 'source' names the reference; 'source_date' is the date the source was consulted (YYYY-MM-DD). Prefer official port-authority / government (.gov.in) sources; secondary sources are labelled as such. Berth entries are created ONLY where dimensions are published; ports without published per-berth dimensions carry port-level constraints and/or UNKNOWN.
